summary: Confirmed live that BotHealthBar bound its stun bar to an EntityProxy (RibCage/PhysicsRig on Spiked/Armored junk/jungledogs) or a boss bubble (MantisBubble/UssamBubble), none of which accumulate stun, while the root entity did. BotHealthBar.Setup now falls back to the root entity when the resolved IStunComponent is a GameEntity without status effects. BombBotEntity no longer strips Damage.Type.Stun (hack/overheat/turbo resistance kept); bombot stun went from 0 to accumulating. Verified in play mode by spawning each type, applying stun-damage interactions every 0.25s and logging root stun vs. the stun bar HealthBarUI value: all affected types now track root stun, and base junkdog/bloodhound/base jungledog are unchanged. No pixel screenshot of the bars (victory screen covered the game view; target captures saw bars edge-on).
instructions:
Investigate and fix a bug: for a number of enemies, the stun bar UI does not visibly fill or change as the enemy takes stun-type damage, yet after enough qualifying hits the enemy does become stunned anyway. This is confirmed present on current master and was also present in build 12010, so it is not a recent regression.

Affected enemies:
1. All junkdogs except the base junkdog and the bloodhound junkdog
2. All bombots
3. All jungledogs except the normal base
4. All bosses

Two separate root causes have already been identified by prior investigation and need to be verified live in the editor, then fixed:

- Bombots: in BombBotEntity.ModifyIncomingInteraction (BombBotEntity.cs, around lines 71-79), Damage.Type.Stun is stripped from every incoming hit, so the stun bar/buffer can never fill from damage. Any stun bombots do get appears to come from a non-damage source (a hack/quirk) calling Stun() directly rather than through the normal stun-accumulation path. Confirm this at runtime and fix ModifyIncomingInteraction so stun-type damage is no longer stripped, restoring normal stun bar accumulation while preserving whatever behavior the stripping was originally meant to support (check git history/comments for intent before removing it outright).

- Junkdogs/Jungledogs (Armored+Spiked variants) and bosses: this looks like a UI binding issue rather than a data/YAML issue. BotHealthBar.Setup binds the stun bar via GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent>(), which for these enemies resolves to the wrong component — an EntityProxy (e.g. Spiked dogs via JunkDogSpikes, Armored dogs via ArmorEntity proxies on PhysicsRig) or a bubble GameEntity (e.g. Mantis/Ussam) — neither of which carries the real status effects/stun accumulation. Because of this the bar reads stunDamage=0 from the wrong component while the actual root entity is the one accumulating stun damage and eventually triggering the stun. Confirm this live in the editor (attach to an affected enemy, watch which component GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent>() resolves to, verify the root entity's stun accumulation vs. what the bar reads), then fix BotHealthBar.Setup (and/or the proxy components' IStunComponent implementation) so it binds to the correct entity's stun state for these enemy types. Do not assume this is a per-prefab stunBuffer override — that has already been ruled out (Armored/Spiked junkdog/jungledog variants all inherit stunBuffer=50, same as base).

Verify the base junkdog, bloodhound junkdog, and normal base jungledog are unaffected and remain so after the fix (they should already display stun bar changes correctly, since they don't go through the proxy/bubble indirection).

Done means: for all listed affected enemy types, the stun bar visibly fills/updates as stun-type damage is taken, matching the enemy actually becoming stunned, verified live in the editor, with no regression to the already-working base junkdog, bloodhound junkdog, or base jungledog.
